result.title: Adversarial Speculative Reasoning Improves Long Horizon Agents
result.summary: Speculative decoding has been treated purely as a systems optimization that speeds up large language model decoding without changing the model behavior. Under this view, the growing effort to train better draft models has been focused solely on acceptance rate. We argue that this view does not hold true for long-horizon agent reasoning. Measuring frontier open-weight models on complex agentic tasks with different speculative decoding approaches, we found that numerical noise grows within verification windows, and the draft acceptance results of the thinking process can change the output distribution of the model after 30 steps, thus noticeably influencing the reasoning accuracy of long-horizon agents in random directions. In this work, we improve the reasoning capability of target models by controlling such noise. While we cannot change the overall token distribution verified by the target model, we can encode critical reasoning with highest precision by training the draft model to be rejected. We identify these points in agent traces and train the draft model to favor adversarial preference. At inference the trained draft and the target part ways precisely at these decision points, verification restarts, so that critical thinking tokens are sampled from the target model and encoded under its least noisy conditions. This approach makes critical reasoning better indexed and more durable over a long horizon. On complex agentic coding benchmarks, our approach raises end-to-end success rate with no change to the target model or its output distribution. Our results recast the speculative decoding mechanism from a pure accelerator into an active allocator for context precision that improves the accuracy of long-horizon agents by training 0.06% to 0.28% of hosted parameters.

AI.brief_summary: 论文指出投机解码在长程 agent 推理中并非纯系统加速：验证窗口内的数值噪声会改变模型输出分布。作者用对抗偏好训练 draft 模型，使其恰在关键推理决策点被拒绝，从而让 target 模型在噪声最小的条件下重新采样这些 token。
AI.relevance_reason: 「以被拒绝为训练目标，把高精度采样定向分配给关键推理步」的机制，可供核查能否迁移到 LVR 中关键 latent 步的计算与精度分配、以及推理步骤贡献分配问题；但研究对象为纯文本 agent 轨迹，与视觉证据筛选无直接关系。
